subject: Time-boxed controls walkthrough + evidence handoff — coordination

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@finline.com>

Cc: Ivan Petrov <ivan.petrov@finline.com>, security_ops@finline.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Controls walkthrough request & evidence handoff

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. Our security team would like to do a short controls walkthrough (SOC 2 scope items + DPA questions) and get the evidence handoff started. We have a narrower window this week and would prefer a 40-minute, time-boxed session that focuses on:

- Data residency and access controls (SOC 2 CC6, CC7)
- Audit log retention and access (examples of logs)
- Encryption & KMS integration details called out in the DPA

Are you available for a 40-min slot on Monday evening (6/28) 17:00–17:40 PT or Tuesday morning 09:00–09:40 PT? If neither works, we can propose a 30-min condensed slot.

Attached: high-level checklist of evidence they'd like to see.

Thanks,
Samira
Security Program Manager
Finline
[Attachment: SOC2-evidence-checklist.pdf]

Hi Samira —

Appreciate the details. We can absolutely run a 40-min, time-boxed session that focuses on those items. Proposed slots from our side:

- Mon 2027-06-28 17:00–17:40 PT (preferred)
- Tue 2027-06-29 09:00–09:40 PT (backup)

Agenda (40 min):
1) 5m quick intros & scope confirmation
2) 20m controls walkthrough (access controls, KMS, retention)
3) 10m evidence and logs handoff (we’ll drop samples to your Drive)
4) 5m open questions & next steps

Ben (cc'd) will join for procurement / contract Qs at the end if there are licensing/ops items to call out. Laura from Platform Security will handle the evidence exchange. We’ll pre-stage the sample logs and a short runbook.

If the Monday slot works, I’ll send a calendar invite with a short pre-read and a drive link for evidence.

Best,
Stephanie
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
